chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who has wealth and has never performed Hajj.
He said, "He is among those of whom Allah the Exalted said, 'And We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind.'"
He said, I said, "Glory be to Allah, blind?"
He said, "Allah made him blind from the path of Paradise."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence for a wealthy Muslim who neglects the obligatory Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets the Quranic verse regarding being gathered blind as a spiritual deprivation for the wealthy who neglect the obligatory Hajj. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that the failure to perform a fundamental pillar due to wealth or negligence results in a specific divine punishment of being cut off from the path to Paradise, emphasizing the urgency of fulfilling this duty once one is financially and physically capable.
